source_format: glTF 2.0 binary GLB; repository-relative production manifests schemaVersion 1
unreal_expected_units: centimeters; verify imported bounds against manifest dimensionsMeters before approval
coordinate_conversion: Importer-managed; verify orientation, handedness, pivot and scale in editor
materials: Inspect actual imported material slots and textures; visually verify base color, normal orientation, roughness and metallic channels
pipeline_policy: Installed glTF pipeline defaults; operator must record project/engine pipeline settings. Adapter does not modify defaults or guess engine plugin asset paths
lod_policy: Each GLB imports separately. External LODs are NOT assigned to the base mesh by this adapter
collision_policy: Collision GLBs import as review geometry only. No collision body/physics assignment claim
animation_policy: Record actual imported AnimSequence objects and duration; compare source clip count. Playback, retargeting and deformation require separate tests
required_remaining_gates: Real editor import and supported-property inspection
Native LOD attachment and distance switching tests
Native collision/physics integration and gameplay tests
